3240-6277-6462-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2645-3181-3230-3430.easyPrerequisites: Krosan Restorer doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3181-3230-3430.description:
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Krosan Restorer by tapping it, untapping Coral Atoll
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Krosan Restorer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4681-5147-5170-8175.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Edgar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Edgar trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it
as a copy of Aminatou and with two or more loyalty counters on it

193-2724-3908-8172.description:
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Karn.
Activate Spark Double's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Spark Double. Choose to have Spark Double enter as a copy of Aminatou that isn't legendary. Wormfang Manta.
Repeat each turn.

147-4247-7281.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-4247-7281.description:
Cast Leonardo's Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Leonardo's Technique.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Leonardo's Technique, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Leonardo's Technique copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2757-3000-4385.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating two creature tokens due to Chatterfang.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic land
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1017-2122-6774.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Loading Zone
Repeat.

3497-4907-5256-6989.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 3 life this turn.
3497-4907-5256-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

2234-4217.description:
Cast Baral's Expertise by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Baral's Expertise, targeting Lutri.
Resolve the copy of Baral's Expertise, returning Lutri from the battlefield to your hand, and casting Lutri from your hand without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.

1399-1606-4249-7223.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 4.
1399-1606-4249-7223.description:
Activate Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

2730-2921-5987.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
When Angel of Indemnity dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Angel of Indemnity
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2457-3000-4289-7175.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2906-3140-7070.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
2906-3140-7070.description:
Activate Soltari Guerrillas by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Soltari Guerrillas.
The Soltari Guerrillas ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Soltari Guerrillas from exile by paying {0} due to Rakdos.
Repeat.

2173-2829-3661-5220.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

328-2511-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.
328-2511-5220-6900.description:
Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

224-3147-3314-3430-6763.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using three in any combination of {W} and/or {U}, and have the mana to cast it.
224-3147-3314-3430-6763.description:
Cast the creature in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from your hand to the battlefield.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Chulane.
Resolve the creature spell cast in step 1.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning the creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

224-4543-6628.description:
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Trench Behemoth.
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping PuPu UFO.
If the land enters untapped and can produce mana, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.

3391-4871-5686-6019.description:
Activate Korozda Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{B}{G} and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Korozda Guildmage ability, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}{G}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

1636-3143-4136-5696.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-4136-5696.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Roaring Earth trigger.
Resolve the Roaring Earth trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2510-3705-5231-5997.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-3705-5231-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

1636-3143-3364.easyPrerequisites: Arlinn, Voice of the Pack has at least three loyalty counters.
1636-3143-3364.description:
Activate Arlinn's loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, creating a 2/2 Wolf creature token that enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing the +1/+1 counter from the Wolf token, creating a copy of the Wolf token that enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Arlinn.
When the Wolf token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

215-876-3172.notablePrerequisites: Forests and green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {7}{G}{G}{G}.
215-876-3172.description:
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {7}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Patron of the Orochi.
Activate Patron of the Orochi by tapping it, untapping all Forests and all green creatures.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Patron of the Orochi to your hand.
Cast Patron of the Orochi by paying {6}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
If Forests and/or green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {8}{G}{G}{G}, this combo nets infinite mana.

890-1029-1372.notablePrerequisites: Cephalid Broker and Palladium Myr do not have summoning sickness.
890-1029-1372.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Cephalid Broker by tapping it, causing you to loot twice.
Tolarian Kraken triggers twice, causing you to pay {2} to untap Palladium Myr and Cephalid Broker.
Repeat.

1295-2503-2890-4892.description:
Cast Flash dropping Hulk, search for Inverter of Truth and Thassa's Oracle.
Stack triggers so Inverter resolves first exiling your library facedown and putting Protean Hulk and Flash back in.
then Oracle resolves with 2 cards in library and 2 devotion for game.

391-2605-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Blossom Dryad.
391-2605-3525.description:
Activate Lotus Vale by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Lotus Vale.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.

65-717-2628-2993-4686.description:
Activate Polluted Mire's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Polluted Mire, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Polluted Mire trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Stoic Builder.
Stoic Builder enters the battlefield, returning Polluted Mire from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
